metadata.description: A small, curated marketplace of focused Claude Code plugins — each does one thing well.

plugins.name: agent-mail-monitor
plugins.description: Read-only Agent Mail surface for swarm agents: auto-arms a background Monitor that notifies on each new message addressed to $AGENT_NAME, plus skills to toggle the watch and diagnose the setup — react to inbound mail without polling, and never mark it read.

plugins.name: ultragoal
plugins.description: Turn a written plan into a self-enforcing run: /ultragoal start @plan.md compiles the plan's acceptance criteria into a machine-checkable rubric, then a Stop hook blocks the session from stopping until every check passes on disk — failing checks feed back as the next marching order. Hash-pinned judge, bounded enforcement (deadline + attempt cap), human bypass verb. start --iterate N (after Karpathy's autoresearch recipe) re-arms on each certified DONE.

plugins.name: rg-flag-guard
plugins.description: PreToolUse hook that catches ripgrep's silent flag traps (-r is --replace, -h is --help — both exit 0 with wrong output) and denies with the corrected command pasted into the reason. Corpus-backed decision table, sees through timeout/xargs/sudo/rtk/snip wrappers, never false-positives on deliberate --replace idioms.

plugins.name: obsidian-gymnast
plugins.description: Skills that let agents drive the Obsidian CLI: the command map (search, frontmatter-as-JSON, appends) plus the silent traps — single-dash flags parsed as CLI commands, restart reusing stale argv, multi-word searches returning empty with exit 0 — with rg/fd fallbacks when the app isn't running.

plugins.name: kittens-saved
plugins.description: Counts the kittens the agent saves by doing the work instead of punting it, and gates its escape hatch: it may only stop cleanly when nothing of its own is left unsaved. Stop-hook reminder, JSONL ledger, statusline segment.
